thread:
alert-bot: :rotating_light: High latency spike detected on inference cluster 'east-prod-gpu-3' (p95 tokens/sec down 60%) starting ~2629812300. Auto-fallback triggered to small-model variants for some routes.

alex: ack — paging now, grabbing logs and KPIs. If anyone else on call, pls chime in.

maria: on call, joining. seeing anomalous KV cache eviction rates in the stream.

samir: confirming — traces show heavy KV cache churn coincident with a quantized model rollout at 2629809000. batching queue depth increased, head-of-line latencies spiked.

alex: mitigation idea: temporarily disable prefix-KV caching for that model variant and route critical customer traffic to non-quantized variant. rolling change? :thinking_face:

maria: do it. I'll open a quick rollback canary to 10% traffic while we flip cache.

helen: FYI support already sees 3 customer tickets (enterprise) about response timeout errors. I raised to priority-high.

alex: running command to disable KV prefix caching for variant `rwd-optim-q4` on cluster east-prod-gpu-3:

```
redwoodctl runtime update-variant --cluster east-prod-gpu-3 --variant rwd-optim-q4 --set kv_cache.enabled=false
```

alex: patch applied. Observability: p95 starting to recover in the last 60s. batching queue depth back to normal for critical routes.

samir: adding a temporary batching cap to prevent runaway batching: `batch.max_tokens=1024` on that variant.

maria: rerouting 90% of enterprise traffic to `rwd-base-v2` until we confirm stability. docs/traffic-routing link shared in thread.

oncall-manager-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1189. Severity: S2. Link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2026-1189

helen: collecting impacted customer list now; will attach to the incident. Suspected root cause: quantization profile + KV cache thrash under a specific request token-length distribution.

ezra: logs snippet (filtered):
```
[2629812310] kv_cache: eviction_rate=0.84, miss_rate=0.63, avg_latency_ms=3.1
[2629812315] batching: queue_depth=48, worker_wait_ms=1200
[2629812320] runtime: model_load=ok, gpu_mem=78%, qprofile=rwd-q-2026
```

alex: agree on preliminary RCA: new quant profile changed KV cache insertion patterns (smaller key reuse), combined with long tail requests triggered big batching delays -> client timeouts.

maria: next actions (live): 1) Keep kv_cache disabled for rwd-optim-q4 on east-prod-gpu-3 (maria) 2) Ramp canary rollback to 100% if stable (alex) 3) Notify customer success & enterprise contacts (helen).

samir: dev plan items: 1) Add eviction policy telemetry to runtime (LRU aging metrics) 2) Add a soft cap on batch size and adaptive batching logic 3) Tighten quant profile validation in CI (blocking perf regressions). I'll PR tickets.

alex: scheduling short postmortem slot tomorrow 10:30am PT. Link: https://meet.redwood.example/pm-2629812345. Who can attend?

helen: I'll be there with customer impact and CS notes.

maria: I'll join and present the mitigation timeline.

samir: will join — will prep kernel/kv cache instrumentation diffs.

ezra: I'll prepare a small repro and perf script for the quant profile.

alex: created postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood.example/postmortems/INC-2026-1189 (draft). Please add action items.

maria: live action items (added to incident doc):
- "Disable KV cache for variant rwd-optim-q4 on east-prod-gpu-3" — done — owner: maria — status: closed — closed_ts: 2629812500
- "Reroute enterprise traffic to rwd-base-v2" — owner: alex — status: in_progress

samir: ongoing remediation tasks (in tech board):
- "Add KV eviction aging metric + alert" — owner: samir — due: 2629990000
- "Introduce adaptive batching cap (soft limit)" — owner: samir — due: 2630190000
- "Quant profile perf gate in CI" — owner: ezra — due: 2630055000

helen: customer comms: drafted notice for impacted customers and mitigation steps. Will send after AM review.

alex: follow-up operational changes we agreed on: 1) runbook update for kv-cache thrash (owner: maria) 2) add a canary rule for quantized profile rollouts (owner: samir) 3) post-deploy perf smoke test for typical enterprise token distributions (owner: ezra).

maria: I'll own runbook; target to publish update in 3 days (2629972345).

samir: opening PR #4821 for canary policy enforcement and will attach automated rollback if p95 > baseline + 30%.

alex: scheduling the postmortem review in calendar and assigning action items to the triage board. Please update statuses in the incident doc with timestamps.

helen: tickets created in support queue, CS notified, escalations flagged for 2 enterprise customers.

ezra: quick note — we should consider exposing a `runtime.kv_cache.force_disable` toggle per-route for emergency mitigation; filing a request.

alex: thanks all. Current cluster metrics stable for 20+ mins; keeping the incident open until postmortem. If anyone uncovers more, post here. :thumbsup:

oncall-manager-bot: Reminder: postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:30am PT. ATTENDEES: alex, maria, samir, helen, ezra.

maria: adding retrospective TL;DR to incident doc after meeting — will include timeline, root-cause hypothesis, and exact remediation steps with PR links.

samir: created tech-ticket: TCK-5482 "KV cache eviction optimization" and linked to postmortem doc.

alex: closing notes for the thread: keep remediation status updated in the incident doc and in the eng-sre board. We'll convert incident doc to final postmortem after review.
